title: Cold. Hot. Sorted.
captions:
Cold. Hot. Sorted. 🔥❄️

Start square at 9.00 psi all round. Come in, record your hot pressures, and Kart Connect works out your cold pressures for the next run, stagger included. 🏁

Run 1: 0.00 psi stagger.
Next run: FL +0.19, FR −0.59, RL +0.63, RR −0.23. That's 1.22 psi of stagger, set up to even out the hots.

No calculator. No guesswork. Just the right pressures, every run.

🔗 kart-connect.com

#KartConnect #Karting #KartRacing #KartSetup #TyrePressures

Hot pressures in. Next cold pressures out. Stagger sorted. 🔥➡️❄️

🔗 kart-connect.com

#KartConnect #Karting #KartSetup #TyrePressures

Still doing tyre pressure maths on the back of a glove? 🧮

Put your hot pressures into Kart Connect after the session and it recommends your cold pressures for the next run, showing you exactly how much stagger you need across the four corners.

Less maths. More grip. 🏎️
